root: ^You step into the Chief Resident's office. Dr. Santos is reviewing a stack of patient files on her desk. She looks up and gives you a warm, gentle smile.
^"Have a seat, Doctor. I have just finished reviewing your consultation logs from your recent shifts."
^"I am highly impressed. You demonstrated sharp clinical reasoning and, more importantly, you built genuine trust with our community."
^"Thank you, Dr. Santos. I learned a lot from the patients."
^"It shows. You adhered to safety protocols and recognized critical warning signs. The Rural Health Unit is lucky to have you."
^"Congratulations on completing your rotation. Welcome to the team as a full-fledged Attending Physician."
^You have successfully completed your Primary Care Training.
